Three extended X-ray structures around the nucleus on kpc scale are well imaged, allowing an in-depth spatially resolved study.

The fundamental domains linked with smart living such as transportation, entertainment, healthcare, and smart cities are anticipated to elevate the level of service quality assuring a high-end user experience.

arxiv-2109-04710.title: High and anomalous thermal conductivity in monolayer MSi 2 Z 4 semiconductors
arxiv-2109-04710.creator: Yan Yin, Min Yi, Wanlin Guo
arxiv-2109-04710.description: Abstract The lattice thermal conductivity ( κ \kappa ) of newly synthesized two-dimensional (2D) MoSi 2 N 4 family and its associated abnormality are anatomized by ab initio phonon Boltzmann transport calculations. κ \kappa of MoSi 2 N 4 and WSi 2 N 4 is found over 400 Wm -1 K -1 at 300 K.

arxiv-2202-01667.description: Abstract Understanding flow structures in urban areas is widely recognized as a challenging concern due to its effect on urban development, air quality, and pollutant dispersion. In this study, state-of-the-art data-driven methods for modal analysis of simplified urban flows are used to study the dominant flow processes in these environments.

arxiv-2209-06896.title: Persistently Feasible Robust Safe Control by Safety Index Synthesis and Convex Semi-Infinite Programming
arxiv-2209-06896.creator: Tianhao Wei, Shucheng Kang, Weiye Zhao, Changliu Liu
arxiv-2209-06896.description: Abstract Model mismatches prevail in real-world applications. Ensuring safety for systems with uncertain dynamic models is critical. However, existing robust safe controllers may not be realizable when control limits exist. And existing methods use loose over-approximation of uncertainties, leading to conservative safe controls. To address these challenges, we propose a control-limits aware robust safe control framework for bounded state-dependent uncertainties.

arxiv-2309-04316.title: Incremental Learning of Humanoid Robot Behavior from Natural Interaction & Large Language Models
arxiv-2309-04316.creator: Leonard Bärmann, Rainer Kartmann, Fabian Peller-Konrad, Jan Niehues, Alex Waibel, Tamim Asfour
arxiv-2309-04316.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Leonard Bärmann, Rainer Kartmann, Fabian Peller-Konrad, Jan Niehues, Alex Waibel, Tamim Asfour. Natural-language dialog is key for intuitive human-robot interaction. It can be used not only to express humans’ intents, but also to communicate instructions for improvement if a robot does not understand a command correctly. Of great importance is to let robots learn from such interaction experience in an incremental way to allow them to improve their behaviors or avoid mistakes in the future.

arxiv-2401-09525.title: Universal Vortex Statistics and Stochastic Geometry of Bose-Einstein Condensation
arxiv-2401-09525.creator: Mithun Thudiyangal, Adolfo del Campo
arxiv-2401-09525.description: Abstract The cooling of a Bose gas in finite time results in the formation of a Bose-Einstein condensate that is spontaneously proliferated with vortices. We propose that the vortex spatial statistics is described by a homogeneous Poisson point process (PPP) with a density dictated by the Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM).

arxiv-2406-09346.title: Scoreformer: A Surrogate Model For Large-Scale Prediction of Docking Scores
arxiv-2406-09346.creator: Álvaro Ciudad, Adrián Morales-Pastor, Laura Malo, Isaac Filella-Mercè, Victor Guallar, Alexis Molina
arxiv-2406-09346.description: Abstract In this study, we present ScoreFormer, a novel graph transformer model designed to accurately predict molecular docking scores, thereby optimizing high-throughput virtual screening (HTVS) in drug discovery. The architecture integrates Principal Neighborhood Aggregation (PNA) and Learnable Random Walk Positional Encodings (LRWPE), enhancing the model’s ability to understand complex molecular structures and their relationship with their respective docking scores.

arxiv-2406-15888.title: Real-time Speech Summarization for Medical Conversations
arxiv-2406-15888.creator: Khai Le-Duc, Khai-Nguyen Nguyen, Long Vo-Dang, Truong-Son Hy
arxiv-2406-15888.description: Abstract In doctor-patient conversations, identifying medically relevant information is crucial, posing the need for conversation summarization. In this work, we propose the first deployable real-time speech summarization system for real-world applications in industry, which generates a local summary after every N speech utterances within a conversation and a global summary after the end of a conversation.

However, its accuracy in practical calculations is limited by the choice of the exchange-correlation potential. In this respect, 2D materials pose a special challenge, as all 2D materials and their heterostructures have a crucial similarity.

pmc-10671950.creator: Panagiota K Stampouloglou, Artemis Anastasiou, Evanthia Bletsa, Stavroula Lygkoni, Flora Chouzouri, Maria Xenou, Ourania Katsarou, Panagiotis Theofilis, Konstantinos Zisimos, Dimitris Tousoulis, Manolis Vavuranakis, Gerasimos Siasos, Evangelos Oikonomou, Fabrizio Montecucco
pmc-10671950.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The global prevalence of diabetes mellitus (DM) has led to a pandemic, with significant microvascular and macrovascular complications including coronary artery disease (CAD), which worsen clinical outcomes and cardiovascular prognosis. Patients with both acute coronary syndrome (ACS) and DM have worse prognosis and several pathophysiologic mechanisms have been implicated including, insulin resistance, hyperglycemia, endothelial dysfunction, platelet activation and aggregations as well as plaque characteristics and extent of coronary lesions.

To delve deeper into this issue, this study aims to investigate the relationship between women’s autonomy and their approval of IPV against women.

pmc-12534169.description: Spindle cell/sclerosing rhabdomyosarcoma (RMS) is an uncommon and aggressive neoplasm, especially in adults. This case details a 35‐year‐old male with a 4‐year history of persistent idiopathic facial pain (PIFP), first misdiagnosed owing to the lack of definitive clinical or radiologic evidence. Advanced imaging ultimately identified a malignant tumor in the infratemporal fossa, which was confirmed as rhabdomyosarcoma through histological examination.

pmc-13534519.title: 血流限制训练对老年肌少症患者肌力及躯体功能的影响
pmc-13534519.creator: 玉祥 梁, 玉琦 午, 雪丽 淳, 锐莉 王, 佼佼 蒋
pmc-13534519.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的探讨血流限制训练对住院老年肌少症患者肌肉力量、躯体功能、功能性移动能力及日常生活活动能力的影响，并比较其与传统抗阻训练的差异，为临床制定康复策略提供科学依据。方法本研究采用随机对照试验设计，共纳入40例经临床诊断为肌少症的住院老年患者，按1∶1比例通过计算机生成随机分配序列分为试验组和对照组，各20例。试验组进行血流限制训练，对照组进行抗阻训练，干预持续12 周，每周3 次。分别于干预前、第4周及第12周对受试者进行评估。主要结局指标为肌肉力量，用优势手握力评估。次要结局指标包括躯体功能、功能性移动能力和日常生活活动能力，分别用简易体能状况量表（short physical performance battery, SPPB）、6 m步速和计时起立－行走测试（timed up and go test, TUG）以及改良的Barthel指数（modified barthel index, MBI）进行测量。结果研究期间无失访，无不良事件发生。干预4周后，两组主要结局指标握力均较基线提升（均P<0.001），试验组握力〔（24.35±5.43） kg〕高于对照组〔（20.96±5.25） kg〕，但两组间差异无统计学意义（P=0.051）；在次要结局指标方面，试验组在SPPB评分和MBI评分方面均明显优于对照组（均P<0.05），TUG测试和6 m步速差异尤为明显（P<0.01）。干预12周后，主要结局指标握力在组间差异上具有统计学意义〔试验组（25.25±5.34） kg，对照组（21.66±5.26） kg，P=0.039〕。在次要结局指标方面，试验组在SPPB评分、6 m步速、TUG测试时间和MBI评分方面均明显优于对照组（均P<0.01）。结论血流限制训练能够明显改善住院老年肌少症患者的肌力、提高老年人躯体功能、功能性移动能力及日常生活活动能力，其效果优于抗阻训练。 肌少症是一种与年龄增长相关的渐进性全身骨骼肌病变，其核心症状包括肌肉量减少、肌力下降及/或躯体功能减退[1]。流行病学研究显示，全球60岁以上老龄人口的肌少症发病率达10%～27%[2]，我国老年人群总患病率为18.4%[3]。在住院老年人群中，由于活动受限及共病等因素，肌少症发生率更高，常导致功能衰退加剧、住院时间延长及医疗负担加重[4-6]。传统抗阻训练虽为主要推荐的运动干预方式，但其高负荷特性对常伴多种疾病、虚弱或耐受性差的住院老年人而言，实施依从性与安全性面临挑战[7-8]。近年来，血流限制训练（blood flow restriction training, BFRT）作为一种抗阻训练替代方案广受关注[9]。它通过在运动肢体近端加压，部分限制血流，使患者在低负荷下运动，即可模拟高强度训练引发的肌肉适应[10-11]。已有研究证实BFRT对健康及社区老年肌少症人群的肌力、肌肉量等功能有改善作用且具备安全性[11-12]。然而，现有研究针对住院老年肌少症患者的研究较少且功能评估多限于肌力与肌肉质量，缺乏对躯体功能与日常活动能力的多维综合评估。因此，本研究旨在通过随机对照试验，探讨BFRT对住院老年肌少症患者躯体功能的影响，综合评估其肌力、步行速度及功能独立性等方面的干预效果。 资料与方法 研究对象 本研究于2024年8月至2025年8月在四川大学华西医院招募老年肌少症住院患者，受试者经过严格筛查并签署知情同意书后入组。纳入标准：（1）符合亚洲肌少症工作组2019年制定的肌少症诊断标准[13-14]；（2）年龄>65岁，自身基础疾病稳定、生命体征平稳；（3）可以日常沟通并能理解与合作。排除标准：（1）存在重度功能障碍（MBI≤40分或依赖轮椅/卧床）；（2）严重认知功能障碍或其他精神疾病；（3）血流限制训练禁忌证：深静脉血栓形成史或潜在危险、凝血功能障碍、静脉曲张等。以主要结局指标握力为依据进行样本量估算：采用 G*Power 3.1 软件，设定双侧 α=0.05、检验效能 80%，预估所需最小样本量为 28 例；考虑到约20%的脱落及不依从风险，最终纳入40例临床诊断为肌少症的老年住院患者。 试验方法 本研究为一项随机对照试验，方案已经四川大学华西医院生物医学伦理委员会批准，批准号2024年审（2579）号，并在ClinicalTrials.gov注册（注册号：NCT06986395）。40例纳入者按 1∶1 比例随机分为试验组和对照组。随机分配序列由计算机生成，对结局评估者、数据采集与统计分析人员实施设盲。两组干预均为每周3次，每次30 min，持续12周，并分别于干预前、第4周和第12周进行评估：主要结局指标为握力，次要结局指标包括简易体能状况量表（short physical performance battery, SPPB）评分、6 米步速、计时起立－行走测试（timed up and go test, TUG）时间及改良 Barthel 指数（modified barthel index, MBI）评分。所有干预及评估措施均由经培训人员规范实施。干预主要在患者住院期间完成，对于在研究周期内部分病情稳定提前出院的患者，提供详细的家庭训练指导与简易设备，并通过每周电话或视频随访确保干预依从性与规范性，所有患者均按计划返院完成各时间点评估。研究流程见图1。 Study flowchart 研究流程图 干预方法 所有患者随机分组后，进行运动安全宣教及常规护理，并间接测量患者上下肢的一次最大重复值（one repetition maximum，1RM）[15]，两组训练过程均由专业、经验丰富的康复治疗师进行一对一指导，试验组接受血流限制训练，对照组进行常规抗阻训练。 血流限制训练干预 该方案以“低负荷血流限制训练”为核心，加压设置如下：上肢训练时加压带置于上臂上1/3处，下肢训练时置于大腿近心端距腹股沟5～10 cm处[16]；初始压力设定参考肢体围度及既往文献（上肢80～100 mmHg、下肢150～200 mmHg，1 mmHg =0.133 kPa），并根据患者主观耐受度（RPE评分12～14分）及皮肤颜色、末梢循环情况进行个体化调整[17]；并于每组动作前充压、组间维持压力，训练结束后立即释放，根据个体耐受度调整以避免不适。训练参数设定为负荷强度20%～30% 1RM，每组10～15次重复，共完成4组，组间休息60 s，每周3次，每次30 min，持续12周[18]。单次训练内容包括肱二头肌屈伸、肩部复合动作（前平举、侧平举）以及股四头肌屈伸膝训练，各项均以坐位姿势双侧执行，每组10～15次。 抗阻训练 该方案以中高强度抗阻训练为核心，训练参数设定为负荷强度65%～75% 1RM，每组10～15次重复，共完成4组，组间休息60 s，每周3次，每次30 min，持续12周。单次训练动作内容与试验组相同，本研究比较的是两种不同训练处方（低负荷BFRT vs 中高强度传统抗阻训练）的整体效果，而非单纯的加压因素。

pmc-13578502.description: BackgroundStandard treatments for meningioma include surgery and radiotherapy, but the timing and technical details of these treatments are debated, particularly as advances in meningioma biology expand options for treatment.
